items.name: Bench axe
items.blurb: Pine haft, soft scrap-iron head. Chops trees in the Tangle and on your land.

items.name: Bench pick
items.blurb: Breaks boulders into quarry stone and drift-stone.

items.name: Bench spade
items.blurb: Digs saplings, roots, herbs, turncap spawn and wild honey.

items.name: Stave bucket
items.blurb: Oak staves, iron hoops. Draws water at the well. The hoops loosen with use.

items.name: Tin watering can
items.blurb: Tarrow tin, bought from Silas. Waters a bed in one go. Watering is never required.

items.name: Brack felling axe
items.blurb: Ash haft, iron head forged by Maren Brack, Hollis's sister. Rehafted by Orrin with a trunnel through the eye.

items.name: Nan's lamplighter pole
items.blurb: A long pole with a hook and a wick-trimmer. Sets lamp heads and trims wicks. Carried, it lights the way a little further than a lantern.

items.name: Oak-mark punch
items.blurb: The Hall's wheel-and-wave stamp. Strikes a wax seal into a standing iron-oak. Never wears.

items.name: Carter's lantern
items.blurb: Lights the way in the dark Tangle; wisps keep a little further off. A fill of candle oil lasts a long while.

items.name: Your own whistle
items.blurb: A plain tin whistle from Pip that you dent to your own note. Echoes nearby answer it.

items.name: Forager's satchel
items.blurb: Salt-stained canvas, string ties. Elara's style. Room for a second keepsake.

items.name: Work apron
items.blurb: Leather, with a pencil pocket. Silas's style. Room for a second keepsake.

items.name: Carting coat
items.blurb: Old Compact cut, deep pockets. Room for a second keepsake.

items.name: Timber
items.blurb: Windfall, mostly. Leave three leafy branches at every stump, as the custom runs.

items.name: Stone
items.blurb: Flat quarry stone for footings and hearths. Never drift-stone for a wall.

items.name: Fiber
items.blurb: Bracken and bark-strip, tough enough to weave.

items.name: Amber
items.blurb: Sap the woods have let go of. Amber is the woods' own memory, set hard and glowing.

items.name: Beeswax
items.blurb: Comes with wild honey. For wax seals and waxed cord.

items.name: Tallow
items.blurb: Bought cheaply from Hazel's kitchen. For oils and salves.

items.name: Lamp Wick
items.blurb: Braided fiber, waxed at the tip. A lamp is only as good as its wick.

items.name: Oilcloth Wrap
items.blurb: Fiber cloth rubbed with linseed. Keeps a paper dry on the road.

items.name: Wooden Peg
items.blurb: A peg for a hook or a hinge. The kind of thing you only miss once.

items.name: Fibre rope
items.blurb: Good for the well's rotten rope, and for lashings.

items.name: Loose road-nail
items.blurb: Common at old lamp-stones. Not one of the Eleven. Fitted to a tool, it wears slower.

items.name: Tarrow-steel edge strip
items.blurb: Salvaged from crate-straps at abandoned carts. Fitted to a tool, it bites deeper: fewer swings.

items.name: Amber bead
items.blurb: Polished at the bench from amber. Fitted to a tool, it gives a faint light in the dark.

items.name: Waxed cord
items.blurb: Fiber and beeswax. Wrapped round a haft, the tool is rarely dropped and a little quieter near wisps.

items.name: Warden-stone sliver
items.blurb: Drift-stone that has learned one shape and always walks back to it. A tool carrying one never breaks.

items.name: Comfrey root
items.blurb: Knobbly, two leaves still on it. Planted, it grows into a comfrey bed.

items.name: Keeper's Twists
items.blurb: Hazel's butter batch. A small mend. "Not quite right," she says.

items.name: Finn's oatcakes
items.blurb: A little mend. Sold in fives, of course.

items.name: Saltings tea
items.blurb: Grey-green and salty. Mana comes back slowly over a minute.

items.name: Comfrey salve
items.blurb: Clears the drift's sway at once. "The hands keep more memory than the head."

items.name: Whittled Fox
items.blurb: A carter's door-fox in soft pine, one ear carved longer than the other. Meant for a lintel somewhere.

items.name: Knotted Ox-Halter
items.blurb: Rope worked in a patient, talkative knot, the kind a driver ties while chatting to the oxen.

items.name: Work Glove
items.blurb: Taken off for a fiddly job and never fetched. It still holds the shape of the hand that left it.

items.name: River Glass Bead
items.blurb: Frosted green glass off a carter's harness, tumbled smooth. The Wend brings down what the first frost throws.

items.name: Tin Whistle
items.blurb: Dented to one clear note. Runners dent their whistles until the note is theirs. Whose note this was, nobody says.

items.name: Beeswax Candle
items.blurb: Never lit, saved for a birthday. The Wilds kept it a long while. Now they've handed it back.

items.name: Spare Bootlace
items.blurb: Waxed leather, still knotted in the double hitch runners use, as if the boot came off a moment ago.

items.name: Stamped Road-Nails
items.blurb: Eleven iron nails, each stamped with the wheel and wave. Lantern-post nails. Eleven exactly.

items.name: Ember Charm
items.blurb: A chip of hearth-grade amber in a twist of wire, still warm from the Ashwatch chest. Your strikes find the gaps more often.

items.name: Tool Rack
items.blurb: Pegs for every tool, each one's fittings on show.

items.name: Stone Hearth
items.blurb: Where hearth recipes are made.

pickups.label: Pick up the coil of rope
pickups.found: A coil of rope, left by the well. Someone meant to mend it.

pickups.label: Pick up the lost glove
pickups.found: A work glove on the lane, still holding the shape of a hand.

pickups.label: Pick up the dropped bucket
pickups.found: A stave bucket in the bracken, hoops a little loose. The woods give things back.

pickups.label: Pick up the paper parcel
pickups.found: Five of Finn's oatcakes, wrapped in paper. Five, of course.
